generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A financial aggregate can look structurally valid while related entities carry incompatible monetary units and minor values are combined without a conversion contract.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Validate that each currency string is individually valid but never assert currency equality across the aggregate and its producers or consumers.
trigger_signals: money aggregate updated by related entity
generalized_learning.reusable_control: REL-SEM-001: before monetary aggregation or settlement, require related entities to share the canonical currency unless an explicit conversion contract is present.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Reject a related monetary operation before mutation when its currency differs from the canonical aggregate currency and no conversion contract exists.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Attack the literal writer plus installment, move, historical-read, forecast, and payment siblings with deliberately divergent currencies and assert no partial mutation.

transfer_cases.evidence: Cross-currency purchase and future installment invoice are rejected before mutation.
Cross-currency invoice-period move is rejected before source, destination, or transaction changes.
Historical mismatch fails closed and payment/forecast boundaries preserve currency identity.

skill_changes.evidence: REL-SEM-001 is represented in the critical attack matrix and inherited controls.
Exact-head domain/API tests exercise the literal case and distinct sibling surfaces.
